notes.title: Prank Masters is Now Available!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33316779/eceb3d04ff39d9143e08685f622ff4c60c73d9bd.png

Our debut otome visual novel, Prank Masters, is now available on Steam!

Become a prank master and show off your pranking skills to win a prank war with or against Romeo, Richard and Kadin.

Feel free to visit the official website here: http://prankmasters.lockviastudios.com/
